title: Report: Steelers G Mason McCormick dislocated his ankle

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Report: Steelers G Mason McCormick dislocated his ankle
sources.description: Steelers left guard Mason McCormick had to leave last Sunday's loss to the Bengals in an air cast after injuring his ankle and that seemed like a preamble to learning that he was out for the season.
